intro: From April to June 2026, ZCyberNews tracked 24 articles on critical infrastructure, with threat actors APT33, CyberAv3ngers, and Interlock among the most frequently observed. The coverage highlighted CVE-2026-24032, a vulnerability with a CVSS score of 7.3, and focused on sectors including energy, utilities, and government across the United States, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. The reporting included 14 high-severity incidents, three critical, one medium, and three informational assessments.
